fields.Name: TSK-10 - Chief of Staff Live Agent Tasks, Transcripts, and Policy Enforcement
fields.Description: Exercises the real Chief of Staff agent via AgentRunner.RunAgent against live DB and live LLM across 4 heuristic checks (TCOSL1-TCOSL4): org-scoped briefing & task discovery, deduplicated task creation, meeting transcript/notes review, and live ReadOnly policy enforcement with zero raw SQL/CRUD invocations.

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: All 4 live Chief of Staff checks reach terminal Completed status with verifyAgentRun passing, typed Tasks/Meetings actions invoked, zero raw SQL/CRUD calls, real DB persistence under ReadWrite, and zero unauthorized mutations under Tasks=ReadOnly.
